purpose: Add explicit approval preparation, source synchronization and real article rendering for six-language technical translations without publishing pending manuscripts.

publicationPolicy.writeCommand: publish requires exact manifest SHA-256, reviewer, actual review PR and explicit approval basis for all twelve editions
publicationPolicy.sourceBinding: English source, private draft and SVG hashes; immutable title/description/categories/tags/slug/body checked again on every build
publicationPolicy.bodyTransformation: Only localized diagram URL changes; source code and reference URLs retained. Astro loader outer-whitespace normalization accounted for.
publicationPolicy.syntheticApproval: render-fixture only in an external disposable non-Git snapshot with original-root and exact-key marker; never a human approval
publicationPolicy.writes: exclusive-create with rollback of files created by this run on conflict
publicationPolicy.assets: only approved SVGs copied into an owned generated namespace; withdrawn assets removed
publicationPolicy.dates: per-language publication dates, not copied English original dates

browser.telemetryIsolation: common isolatedContext with service workers blocked

limits: First fixed technical batch only; additional batches require explicit manifest support.
Additional-language learning guides and curated previous/next paths remain untranslated; same-language related posts use existing matching.
Approval records cannot prove source truth, independent semantic review or actual search indexing.
No user publication approval, merge, deployment or indexing submission performed.
